item.title: Just three days away: SCC gears up for a fun night celebrating business excellence
item.description: (SCC) — The countdown is almost over! The Saipan Chamber of Commerce is thrilled to remind the community that its most anticipated annual signature event, the 2025 Business Person of the Year & Board of Directors Installation Gala, is just three days away! The post Just three days away: SCC gears up for a fun night celebrating business excellence appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: CNMI DOL hosts MSHA compliance assistance presentation
item.description: (CNMI DOL) — The local Department of Labor, in coordination with the Mine Safety and Health Administration or MSHA, hosted a compliance assistance presentation on Jan. 23, 2026, from 9:30 a.m. to 11:30 a.m. at the American Memorial Park indoor theater to strengthen mine safety awareness and regulatory preparedness within the CNMI. The post CNMI DOL hosts MSHA compliance assistance presentation appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: PSS conducts school traffic vulnerability assessments across Saipan, Tinian, and Rota
item.description: (PSS) — The Public School System successfully conducted school traffic vulnerability assessments at all public school campuses across Saipan, Tinian, and Rota to enhance student safety and improve traffic conditions in and around school zones. The post PSS conducts school traffic vulnerability assessments across Saipan, Tinian, and Rota appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Governor, lt. governor swear in key board and commission members
item.description: (Office of the CNMI Governor) — Gov. David M. Apatang and Lt. Gov. Dennis James C. Mendiola officially administered the oaths of office to several newly confirmed members of vital Commonwealth boards and commissions on Friday, Jan. 16, 2026. These appointments follow formal confirmation by the Senate during its 1st day, third regular session. The post Governor, lt. governor swear in key board and commission members appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Casa Marianas becomes latest ProaPerks partner
item.description: (NMC) — All card-carrying members of Northern Marianas College’s ProaPerks program can now avail themselves of exclusive discounts and passes at Casa Marianas, Saipan’s first co-working space and digital nomad hotel. The post Casa Marianas becomes latest ProaPerks partner appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Governor cites constitutional concerns in vetoing local language bill
item.description: GOVERNOR David M. Apatang last week vetoed Senate Bill 24-4, which would have required high and middle school students to attend Chamorro and Carolinian language classes for one year. The post Governor cites constitutional concerns in vetoing local language bill appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: DHS to challenge bond release of former IPI chairwoman
item.description: THE U.S. Department of Homeland Security plans to appeal a Saipan immigration judge’s decision to grant a $10,000 bond for the temporary release of former Imperial Pacific International Chairwoman Lijie Cui, who is facing removal proceedings for allegedly overstaying her E‑2C long‑term investor visa. The post DHS to challenge bond release of former IPI chairwoman appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Man with prior burglary convictions faces new charges
item.description: A MAN previously convicted in multiple burglary cases is facing new charges after he was arrested for breaking into a parked vehicle on Capital Hill earlier this month. The post Man with prior burglary convictions faces new charges appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.description: AFTER ruling that the prosecution failed to follow required criminal procedures, the Superior Court on Monday dismissed without prejudice all misconduct-in-public-office charges against Lt. Gov. Dennis James C. Mendiola and co-defendants Department of Fire and Emergency Medical Services Lt. Justin Paul Mizutani and CNMI Homeland Security and Emergency Management employee Joey Vincent Dela Cruz. A dismissal without prejudice means the charges may be refiled.
